title: Mahesh Raut moves Bombay High Court for permission to travel to Kerala for Ayurvedic treatment
description: Mahesh Raut, an accused in the Bhima Koregaon-Elgar Parishad case of 2018, has moved the Bombay High Court after a special court rejected his plea to travel to Kerala for Ayurvedic treatment in January 2026. [Mahesh Raut v.
